title_en: GTA 6 Reveal: 15 New Screenshots, Including 1 Exclusive on IGN
summary_en: GTA 6 is now fully revealed by Rockstar Games, and IGN has 15 brand new screenshots — including one exclusive screenshot.
body_en:
GTA 6 is now fully revealed by Rockstar Games, and IGN has 15 brand new screenshots — including one exclusive screenshot.
First off, the IGN-exclusive GTA 6 screenshot, below, which shows dual protagonists Lucia and Jason mid-robbery. Expect plenty of that throughout the game.
And now for the rest of the screenshots, which show off GTA 6 in a new light.
Netflix’s GTA 6 gameplay reveal is now live, and so is IGN’s extensive exclusive content. Be sure to check out IGN’s GTA 6 reveal live blog so you don’t miss a thing.
Wesley is Director, News at IGN. Find him on Twitter at @wyp100. You can reach Wesley at wesley_yinpoole@ign.com or confidentially at wyp100@proton.me.
